glossary.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
glossary.role: Ancient precursor civilisation; the found song/poem plates are judged to be Protoculture artefacts.
The in-universe 1970s-style super robot anime (full title ゲキ・ガンガー3) loved by Gai Daigoji and Akito; also the name of its robot.
Nergal mass-produced mecha; used alone and in エステバリス隊 (Aestivalis squad/team).
The people who serve Orphan and pilot Grand Chers to gather its plates; plural 'Reclaimers'
Gigantic sentient alien ship buried under the Pacific; its awakening threatens Earth; base of the Reclaimers

glossary.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
glossary.role: Space-jump (fold) drive of the Macross; Nadesico gets caught in the Macross space fold.

Emperor ruling the Pentagona World from Sveto on Gastogal; supreme commander of the Poseidal Army. The Poseidal on the throne is actually Mian Qu Ha Ussher, a puppet of the true Poseidal (Amandara Kamandara). In ACE2 'Poseidal' is the pilot of the Aug.
glossary.personality: Regal, cold and imperious ruler who controls others (e.g. Quwasan) through the bio-relation system; her memories are themselves manipulated, and she finally turns against Amandara.

glossary.role: The alien Grados Empire, from the Udoria system, that invades and occupies Earth in Layzner. Adjective form: Gradosian.
Main antagonist; Lord of House Luft in the Kingdom of Ah (アの国), who summons Holy Warriors and wages war to unite Byston Well; commands the Will Wipps
glossary.personality: Ambitious, scheming warlord who believes his conquest is justified. Loves his daughter Riml but is blind to the plots around him.

glossary.role: Orphan's disc plates sought by the Reclaimers; ALSO (crossover) inscribed plates carrying a Zentradi/Protoculture song.

glossary.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
glossary.role: SDF-1 Macross, the U.N. Spacy super-dimensional fortress (human flagship).

glossary.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
glossary.role: Idol singer aboard the Macross; her songs (culture) are the key to defeating the Zentradi.
glossary.personality: Bright, cheerful and ambitious pop idol, somewhat self-absorbed; infatuated with Hikaru.

glossary.role: Original Aestivalis pilot of the Nadesico (real name Jiro Yamada); killed early in the TV series
glossary.personality: Loud, hot-blooded, obsessed with Gekiganger III; insists Gai is his soul's name

report.translator_summary: Translated all 80 rows of Op 21 Phase 4 and Debriefing. Covers Focker and Hikaru's rescue reunion, Gai Daigoji chasing Minmay, battle against Milia's Meltrandi/Zentradi forces, the space fold separation, Vrlitwhai and Exsedol's interrogation of the prisoners and dialogue on culture/songs/Gekiganger/Protoculture plates, and Admiral Misumaru's debriefing on the state of Earth after one month (Grados, Poseidal, Orphan surface).
